entities.summary: Benjamin Joseph Gamel is an American professional baseball outfielder in the Atlanta Braves organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Yankees, Seattle Mariners, Milwaukee Brewers, Cleveland Indians, Pittsburgh Pirates, San Diego Padres, New York Mets, and Houston Astros. He made his MLB debut in 2016.
